title: The Help: the Ref button paragraph into sub-bullets
⌃⌘G doesn't cycle on a retyped number
Taliessin through Logres: no page labels, the last page's notes as ::: note fences on their poems
detail: Asked: review the formatting of Williams, or perhaps older works in general (22:17): "The fact that the two Williams pieces I looked at have this problem suggest that it's a wider problem." Begun as S13 on Taliessin through Logres: "none of the pages have both prose and verse, so there it should probably just be 'Line ____', and the notes on the final page should probably be turned into ::: note fences on the poems they refer to. And we probably don't need page numbers at all." Also: "all the italic lines in the poems in Taliessin through Logres are part of the poem and should have line numbers (so <line>)." Victorian Narrative Verse "has hard-coded line numbers at the ends of lines, and footnotes to verse before the ::: note block existed so probably needs to be reformatted" (not read all the way through). Why: page labels give 44 Williams entries a Line-or-Page bar (MEASURED), notes sit apart from what they gloss, italic lines of the poems go unnumbered, and typed line numbers stand in the text; two works read, both with these, so likely more. Done when: the older works' formatting is surveyed (which works, which faults, counted over the backup), each fault has a decided form, and one-offs' import folders set them right, each review page read before import.
